description: Périmètre de 2km autour des secteurs de développement à proximité des gares - SDRIF-E is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Île-de-France, L'Institut Paris Region. Matérialisation des secteurs de développement à proximité des gares. Orientation réglementaire 92bis Il s’agit de valoriser les secteurs les mieux desservis par les transports collectifs, ou devant l’être à terme. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Aménagement du territoire, Déplacements - transports, Vie économique - innovation. Its keywords are SDRIF-E, SDRIF Environnemental, Gare, Urbanisation, geoidf, IDG. The portal shows 418 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
